Hi Carlos / team,

Thanks for the time today — excited to follow up with a technical demo tailored to your engineers and security folks. To make sure we cover the stuff that matters to Acme, I'd like to include:
- A 45–60 minute Solutions Engineering deep-dive covering architecture, integration patterns, and latency/cost tradeoffs
- Time for live Q+A with your engineering team (KV cache, batching, quantization implications)
- A short security/compliance segment for Tom & procurement topics for Priya (data isolation, retention, audit logs, SOC2 artifacts)

Would any of these slots work for your team next week (all Pacific):
- Tue 2026-02-17 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-02-18 14:00–15:30
- Thu 2026-02-19 09:00–10:30

If none of these work, share a few windows and we’ll coordinate. Attendees from our side: me (AE), Soojin (SE) and Dev (SE/RTO).

Attached is a brief draft agenda for Soojin to run through — happy to adjust.

Thanks,

2) 30 min — Architecture & integration patterns (Sooj)
